about: Synthetic messages written on 25 Oct 2026 to probe the overnight extractor changes (bank transaction SMS, possessive bank names, pay verbs, authority anchors, conditional warnings). 'flagged': a scam that must stay AMBER or RED. 'not_red': a genuine message that must never be RED. 'known_gap': a scam that is GREY today (out of scope, or no rule yet), kept so the gap stays visible.
